name: How long does a typical wood trim repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical wood trim repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a wood trim repair varies greatly depending on the extent and complexity of the damage. Minor surface splits might take a few hours to prepare and fill, plus drying time for fillers and paint. More extensive repairs involving structural reinforcement or multiple pieces could take a full day or more, especially if multiple coats of paint or stain are needed. As a Practical Tradeoff, rushing the drying times between steps can compromise the durability and finish, so we always allocate sufficient time for proper curing to ensure a lasting repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time depends on damage complexity; minor splits take hours, while extensive repairs can take a day or more, including drying times. Proper curing is essential for durability.
